name: quoxplan
tagline: The roadmap companion that answers what matters now.
description: Full project-management surface for Quox streams: focus lens, board and timeline views, governed plan editing, and phase/note timelines. Every capability is an API first, so Claude sessions can brief on a stream and append notes with zero local install.
shortDescription: Roadmap and stream planning for Quox devs
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Focus lens: what matters now in under five seconds, not a wall of streams
Board and dependency-sequenced Timeline views for parallel-opportunity reads
Plans as first-class rendered, versioned markdown documents
Governed edit mode: every mutation lands in an append-only event log
Every capability is an API first, reaching Claude via QuoxMCP auto-registration

focusLens.name: Focus Lens
focusLens.description: Default view: blockers, decisions needed, and stale in-flight streams. A handful of cards, never a wall.

timeline.name: Dependency Timeline
timeline.description: Gantt-style view auto-sequenced from dependencies, priority, and effort. See what runs in parallel and what's gating what.

editMode.name: Governed Edit Mode
editMode.description: One explicit toggle flips a view into editing. Every mutation is logged to an append-only event feed.

plans.name: Rendered Plans
plans.description: Markdown plan documents, versioned, editable in place with live preview.

roady.name: ROADY Rail
roady.description: Roadmap agent panel inside QuoxPlan. Comes online once wired to the ROADY agent.

default_roadmap.label: Default Roadmap
default_roadmap.description: QuoxPlan roadmap id to open by default when the plugin loads (leave blank to show the roadmap picker).

show_demo_corpus.label: Show Demo Corpus
show_demo_corpus.description: Include the fictitious Meridian demo roadmaps alongside the org's own roadmap. Useful for onboarding and before the live migration; safe to turn off once real streams are in place.

specialist.name: ROADY
specialist.description: Roadmap agent: orientation briefs, focus analysis, governed roadmap writes
